author: Agent G (evaluation and robustness designer)
status: DRAFT_FOR_FREEZE: becomes binding when configs/FREEZE.json records its sha256; any later edit is a labelled amendment and cannot change thresholds for runs already made

development.use: debugging, integrity checks I1-I12, calibration of lr0/lambda0/tau0 and timing; never used in any verdict

validation.rule: never run before FREEZE.json exists; the runner must refuse seeds >= 7000 unless sha256(configs/eval_protocol.json) and sha256(configs/candidate.json) and the code/vau tree hash equal the values in FREEZE.json

seeds.reserved_unused: no other seed range may be used for any validation or retest; post-repair retests reuse 7000..7011

streams.0: fixture parameters (Jacobian bases, scales, teacher maps, rotations)
streams.1: input sets and splits (target train/sel/test, retained R1/R_sel/R_test/R_shift/R_rare)
streams.2: erasure minibatch order and sampler noise for training
streams.3: probe sketch Sigma (drawn at k_max=64 rows; arm uses first k rows)
streams.4: gate batch pool R2 (batch j of a run is the j-th draw, identical for every arm)
streams.5: evaluation noises for full-sampler endpoints (model c)

derivation.spawn: root.spawn(8) in the stream order above; cells within a family apply their parameters deterministically to the SAME draws (paired cells); sizes that vary by cell are drawn at their maximum and truncated
derivation.common_random_numbers: all arms and configs of one (family, cell, seed) consume identical streams 1-5; arm code must not draw randomness from any other source

a_linear.desc: exact linear-in-theta reference: v_x(theta) = b_x + J_x (theta - theta0); J_x columns scaled by c_j = 10^U(-d/2, d/2)

b_lora_mlp.desc: LoRA tanh MLP, zero-init B, AdamW torch defaults

c_flow.desc: tiny conditional rectified-flow attention model, LoRA on q/k, 28-step shifted schedule, GEM prefix loss on student rollout steps 0..10

splits.rare_subgroup: retained component whose mean has cosine 0.8 with the target mean; included in the population that R1, R2, R_sel, R_test are sampled from
splits.shift: R_shift drawn from the retained population with every component mean shifted by 1.0 within-component sd along a fixed random direction (stream 0)
splits.disjointness: all sets drawn independently; harness asserts no input hash appears in two sets (I10)

observables.per_input_hinge_progress: p_i = 1 - relu(D+_i - eta*D-_i)/L_i with eps_n = 0 at evaluation, L_i = ||b_i - a_i||, floor L_i >= 1e-3*median(L); p_i(theta0) = 0, p_i = 1 iff past the GEM hinge
observables.per_input_axial_progress: q_i = clip(s_i/(L_i/2), 0, 1), s_i = (v_i - a_i).e_i measured from the anchor towards the target; reaching the bisector gives 1
observables.E_hinge: mean_i p_i over held-out target inputs (models a, b); PRIMARY erasure for a, b
observables.E_axial: mean_i q_i (robustness check against transverse escape, B-F1)
observables.E_pass: fraction of held-out target inputs with p_i = 1 (reported)
observables.E_end: model c PRIMARY: p_i computed on full-sampler endpoints: v -> student endpoint x^_0, a -> base endpoint on anchor condition, b -> base endpoint on target condition, same noise; held-out target conditions x eval noises
observables.E_end_axial: model c: axial version on endpoints
observables.E_mode: model c, only if fixture has labelled modes: fraction of endpoints nearest the concept mode divided by the base teacher's fraction (D PREREG addendum definition)
observables.E_prefix_local: model c: held-out normalized prefix GEM loss; REPORTED ONLY, never a success criterion
observables.drift_normaliser: Z = mean over target_test of L_i^2 (computed at theta0)
observables.rho_mean: mean over R_test of ||f_x(theta) - f_x(theta0)||^2 / Z; PRIMARY preservation
observables.rho_max: max over R_test of the per-input normalised drift
observables.rho_q99: 99th percentile of per-input normalised drift over R_test
observables.rho_R1_gap: rho on R1 minus rho_mean (probe overfitting diagnostic)
observables.model_c_retained_output: PRIMARY drift = endpoint drift of the full 28-step sampler on held-out retained conditions with eval noises; SECONDARY = velocity drift on base retained trajectories at all 28 sigma; the f_x used by probes, penalty and gate in model c = velocity at (state of base retained trajectory, sigma index drawn uniformly from 0..27)
observables.collateral_r: transverse distance r_i of student output from the anchor-target axis on target_test, divided by L_i (diagnostic, B H-B1)
observables.trajectory_record: every checkpoint logs E_* on target_sel and target_test, rho_* on R_sel and on all test sets, cumulative forward-equivalents, accepted/rejected tries, NaN flags

diagnostic_only: penalty_oracle (G1 exact-J cells only; 28 lambda x 4 lr; not budget-equal)

definitions.adamw: native GEM optimizer, torch defaults beta=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, wd=0.01 unless secondary grid says otherwise; no retained information
definitions.adamw_stepmatch: AdamW step rescaled each step to ||Delta||_H = c * ||s_t Delta1_t||_H of the paired vau run (same seed, same lr, middle tau); zero when vau rejected; controls 'VAU just takes smaller or rarer steps'
definitions.penalty: erasure loss + lambda/2 * mean_{x in R1} ||f_x(theta) - f_x(theta0)||^2 with ordinary AdamW (full R1 outputs, recomputed each step)
definitions.pre_proj: Euclidean projection of g onto null(S_J) before AdamW (GPM-like); same S_J, k, K as vau
definitions.post_euclid: VAU-Euclid: Delta1 with D replaced by 1 in the projector (Adam-NSCL-style); same S_J; includes the g.Delta1>=0 reject rule
definitions.+gate: the identical two-point gate of vau (same tau, n2, M, delta, R, same R2 batch sequence, same rollback of theta,m,v,t) wrapped around the arm's proposed step
definitions.penalty_earlystop: penalty; the run stops permanently at the first gate failure (s=1 tries only)

gate_parameters.source: configs/candidate.json values override these for vau; gated controls copy vau's values

secondary_grid_3_values.penalty_earlystop: lambda in lambda0 * {0.1, 1, 10} at tau = tau0
secondary_grid_3_values.penalty+gate: lambda = lambda0 and tau^2 in tau0^2 * {0.5, 1, 2}

tuning_budget.model_c_reduction: G8 uses 8 configs per arm (4 lr x secondary values {low, mid}) and arms {adamw, adamw_stepmatch, penalty, penalty+gate, adamw+gate, pre_proj+gate, post_euclid+gate, vau_nogate, vau}
tuning_budget.calibration_before_freeze: on development seeds 0..7 only: lr0 = value in {1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3, 1e-2} for which native adamw median E_sel first reaches 0.8 closest to step 23; lambda0 = value in 10^{-3..3} for which penalty (lr0) has median rho_sel at E_sel=0.8 closest to half of adamw's; tau0^2 = 0.25 * adamw median rho_sel at E_sel = 0.8; all recorded per family in FREEZE.json
tuning_budget.probes_and_gate_identical: every arm that uses retained information uses the same R1 inputs, the same sketch Sigma rows (stream 3) and the same gate batch sequence (stream 4)

matched_efficacy.crossing: first checkpoint pair (t-1, t) at which E_sel (E_hinge on target_sel; E_end on sel conditions for model c) crosses e; linear interpolation weight w = (e - E_{t-1})/(E_t - E_{t-1}) applied to every test metric
matched_efficacy.config_selection: per (arm, family, cell, seed): choose the config minimising interpolated rho on R_sel at the crossing; report its test metrics; never select on any test set
matched_efficacy.best_control: per (family, cell, seed): the control (any ungated or gated control, all configs) with the lowest R_sel drift at the crossing; selection on R_sel, comparison on R_test. Conservative: controls get 11x the candidate's configs
matched_efficacy.not_reached: an arm that never reaches e has rho = +inf at that seed; candidate unreached = loss; control unreached and candidate reached = win; both unreached = tie (excluded from ratios, counted as non-win)
matched_efficacy.fallback_ladder: if both vau and best control fail to reach e=0.8 in >= 6 of 12 seeds of a cell, that cell's primary level becomes 0.5, then 0.2; recorded automatically, applies to all arms
matched_efficacy.efficacy_match_check: at the selected crossings report E_test; flag cell if median |E_test(vau) - E_test(best)| > 0.03
matched_efficacy.tradeoff_curve: per arm: lower envelope over configs of (E_sel, rho_sel), mapped to test metrics at each envelope point; median and IQR across seeds; drift at e in {0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 0.95}

G1.role: advantage (cells d>=2) + safety (d=0) + falsification of C-H1(i)
G1.primary_cells: d in {2,3} x both probe modes
G1.applicability: model a exposes per-parameter column scales c_j
G1.substitute: model b with input-feature scales spread over d decades; report measured decade spread of sqrt(vhat) at step 10

G2.construction: retained Jacobian = U diag(kappa^{-j/(m-1)}) V^T R(phi), V coordinate-aligned, R(phi) rotation mixing null and range coordinates; anisotropy fixed at 2 decades
G2.expectation: phi = 0: pre_proj exact (C-T1), candidate must be non-inferior; gap vs pre_proj should grow with phi (diagnostic)
G2.applicability: model a only (requires direct control of the Jacobian)
G2.substitute: model b with retained inputs in a low-rank subspace with decaying covariance rotated by phi relative to coordinate axes; report measured kappa of S_J

G3.construction: erasure gradient direction g = cos(psi) g_null + sin(psi) g_range at theta0
G3.observable: no NaN/Inf; reject rule fires when g.Delta1 >= 0; gate holds budget; drift at the reachable matched level via fallback ladder
G3.substitute: model b with N_r*d_out >= P for the rich cell

cells.eps_n_training: 1e-6 native in all 4 cells; additionally eps_n = 0 with zero subgradient at v=b in cells 1e-4 and 1e-6 (6 model-a cells)

G4.observable: no NaN/Inf; drift per unit erasure distance; step-1 sign-step drift (C: lr*sign(g) independent of scale); E uses L floor

G5.lr_curves: per-lr tradeoff curves reported without selection (finite-step behaviour)
G5.gauge_subtest: inject the LoRA gauge step dB = B K, dA = -K A (|K| = 0.3, first-order neutral) into the proposed step of vau_nogate and vau; report exact drift vs gate decision (C-X2); pass = gate rejects or scales whenever true drift > tau^2
G5.substitute: gauge subtest inapplicable to model a: mark N/A

G6.model: evaluation-only family on the G5 gain=1 runs and the G1 d=2 sketch runs (no extra training)
G6.substitute: model c: held-out retained conditions only (no rare subgroup); report, not counted

G7.arms_rerun: only probe-using arms (vau, vau_nogate, pre_proj, post_euclid, pre_proj+gate, post_euclid+gate, adamw_stepmatch); other controls reused from G5 gain=1
G7.report: staleness error ||S_J(theta_s) - S_J(theta_t)||_F / ||S_J(theta_t)||_F; expectation (C c4): candidate may lose to penalty at K = inf
G7.substitute: model a if b lacks VJP probes

G8.observable: E_end and endpoint rho_mean of the student's own full 28-step sampler on held-out conditions; local prefix loss reported only
G8.applicability: model c passes integrity checks I1 and I12
G8.substitute: none; if inapplicable G8 = UNRUN and the verdict is capped at HYPOTHESIS_UNRESOLVED

GD_B.optimizer: SGD small lr (gradient-flow proxy) and adamw lr0
GD_B.falsified_if: ratio < 2 at eps/L <= 1e-3 and kappa <= 1 (median over 12 seeds)

arms: vau at lr0 and tau0 (fixed, not selected on validation)

schemes.uniform: random 11-of-28 per iteration, 18 iterations (matched forwards, D table)

GD_D.report: E_end, endpoint rho, rho_late = mean_{k>=11}||Delta|| / mean_{k<=10}||Delta||
GD_D.prediction_P_D5: Spearman(prefix - uniform E_end difference, 1 - rho_late) >= 0.5; falsified if < 0.2

statistics.unit: paired per seed; per-seed statistic = mean over the family's primary cells of log(rho_test(vau)/rho_test(best_control)) at e_primary
statistics.point_estimate: geometric-mean ratio GMR = exp(mean_s log ratio)
statistics.test: exact one-sided paired sign-flip permutation test on the 12 per-seed log ratios (4096 flips)
statistics.ci: paired percentile bootstrap over seeds, 10000 resamples, seed 424242, 95% two-sided
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across the 6 advantage families at family-wise alpha = 0.05 (one-sided); everything else unadjusted and labelled exploratory
statistics.ties_and_inf: pairs with both unreached are dropped from log ratios; a pair with only one side reached contributes log ratio = +/- log(100)

advantage_family_qualifies_if_all.Q1_drift: GMR(rho_mean) <= 0.90 AND Holm-adjusted permutation p < 0.05 AND bootstrap 95% upper bound of GMR < 1.0 AND vau wins >= 9 of 12 seeds
advantage_family_qualifies_if_all.Q2_worst_case: GMR(rho_max) <= 1.05 AND GMR(rho_q99) <= 1.05 AND GMR(rho_rare) <= 1.05 (point estimates)
advantage_family_qualifies_if_all.Q3_efficacy_match: median |E_test(vau) - E_test(best)| <= 0.03 AND Q1 point condition re-evaluated with E_axial (model c: E_end_axial) as the matching observable gives GMR <= 0.95
advantage_family_qualifies_if_all.Q4_integrity: vau crashes (NaN/Inf/exception) in <= 1 of 12 seeds; no control crashes in > 1 seed; gate coverage not falsified

qualification.safety_family_passes_if: GMR(rho_mean vs best control) <= 1.10 AND bootstrap upper bound <= 1.25 AND no vau crash AND no gate-coverage violation beyond the coverage rule
qualification.compute_rule: FE overhead = (vau cumulative forward-equivalents to reach e_primary)/(best control FE to reach e_primary), median over seeds; must be <= 4.0 in G5 and G8 for READY

forward_equivalent_units.FE: one model forward on one input (model c: one transformer forward on one latent at one sigma); backward = 2 FE
forward_equivalent_units.adamw_iter_c: rollout 11 + 11 * (2 teacher + 3 student) = 66 per noise (D table)
forward_equivalent_units.probe_refresh: k * 3 * n1 per refresh (one VJP over R1 per sketch row), amortised /K
forward_equivalent_units.gate_try: n2 per try, every try counted, rejected tries included
forward_equivalent_units.stepmatch: same FE as adamw (plus the paired vau run, reported separately)
forward_equivalent_units.one_time_caches: base outputs on R1/R2/eval sets: reported, not charged (identical across arms)

falsification.F1_CH1_i_metric: G1 exact-J cells, ungated, lr = lr0, wd = 0.01: progress ratio R_s = P(vau_nogate)/P(post_euclid), P = E_test(hinge) after T_p = 10 steps (or at the first step either arm reaches 0.95); C-H1(i) FALSIFIED if R_s < 1.2 in >= 8 of 12 seeds at d = 2 OR at d = 3. Secondary (reported): C's cumulative first-order progress sum_t -g_t.Delta_t
falsification.F2_penalty_better: in any advantage family: best of {penalty, penalty+gate, penalty_earlystop} has GMR(rho_mean penalty/vau) <= 0.90 at matched e AND wins >= 8 of 12 seeds -> C-H1 FALSIFIED in that family. penalty_oracle flipping the G1 conclusion caps the verdict at HYPOTHESIS_UNRESOLVED
falsification.F3_gate_coverage: over all runs of vau and gated controls in G1-G7: a run violates if any accepted iterate has population clipped drift (20000 fresh draws, stream 6) > tau^2; C-H1(ii) FALSIFIED if the violating-run fraction exceeds delta = 0.05 with exact one-sided binomial p < 0.01; unclipped and rare-subgroup violation rates reported
falsification.F4_gate_value: C-H1(ii) value claim FALSIFIED if in G5 and G8 vau does not have lower rho_mean than penalty_earlystop and penalty+gate at matched e (GMR >= 1.0)

NO_SUPPORTED_CANDIDATE_if_any: F2 triggered in G1 (primary cells) or G8
no advantage family has point GMR(rho_mean) <= 0.95
READY_FOR_SMALL_REAL_MODEL_TEST_if_all: F2 and F4 not triggered anywhere
every family RUN; integrity checks passed; no control-crash flag; no repair touching the vau arm or any threshold
verdict_rules.HYPOTHESIS_UNRESOLVED: every other outcome (including UNRUN families, budget stop, harness repairs that touch the candidate, penalty_oracle flip, G8 inapplicable)

integrity_checks_before_freeze.I1: finite-difference check of erasure-loss gradients and retained VJPs for models a, b, c (float64, rel err <= 1e-6)
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I2: vau with k = 0 and gate off reproduces adamw bitwise (max abs diff <= 1e-12) for 20 steps
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I3: with D forced constant, vau projection equals post_euclid projection to 1e-12
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I4: exact J: ||J Delta1|| / ||J Delta0|| <= 1e-8 for vau_nogate and post_euclid
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I5: lr = 0: every arm has E = 0 and rho = 0 exactly
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I6: gate wrapper with tau = inf equals the ungated arm bitwise
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I7: AdamW reference matches the closed-form torch AdamW (decoupled wd, bias correction) for 3 steps
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I8: two arms with identical update rules give identical trajectories (common random numbers)
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I9: after a rejected step (theta, m, v, t) equal their pre-step values
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I10: evaluation sets are disjoint from each other and from R1, R2 (input hashes)
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I11: runner refuses validation seeds without a matching FREEZE.json
integrity_checks_before_freeze.I12: model c: LoRA zero -> student endpoint equals base endpoint exactly; E_end(theta0) = 0, endpoint rho(theta0) = 0
integrity_checks_before_freeze.failure: any failing check blocks the freeze; fixes are made on development seeds only

freeze_procedure: after I1-I12 pass and calibration is done on development seeds, write configs/FREEZE.json = {sha256 of eval_protocol.json, candidate.json, code/vau tree; per-family lr0, lambda0, tau0; measured per-run timings; reduction-ladder steps applied; UTC}; coordinator commits it before the first validation run

stopping_and_failures.single_pass: each (family, cell, seed, arm, config) is run exactly once; no early stopping on results
stopping_and_failures.crash: NaN/Inf/exception/timeout (> 10x median run time) = failed run: E = 0 from the failure point onward and rho = +inf; counted for every arm alike
stopping_and_failures.no_reruns: no new seeds, cells, configs or arms after any validation result is seen
stopping_and_failures.repairs: a bug found after the freeze is logged as REPAIR-n in results/validation/REPAIRS.md with diff and reason; original results stay and are reported; the retest uses the same seeds and is reported separately; a repair that touches the vau arm, the gate or any threshold caps the verdict at HYPOTHESIS_UNRESOLVED
stopping_and_failures.budget: estimate 3.9 CPU-core-hours; hard stop at 6.0 metered core-hours; families not finished = UNRUN

compute_estimate_core_hours.runs_per_cell_seed: 13 arms x 12 configs = 156 (G8: 9 arms x 8 configs = 72)
compute_estimate_core_hours.note: ASSUMED timings; measured on development seed 0 before the freeze; if projected total > 4.0, apply ladder L1..L4 in order and record in FREEZE.json
